of the Division of Loans and Currency of the '1reasur Ike atmwn4 engaged
on work in connection with war measures creating a National emergency,
and by virtue of the provisions of the Act of Congress approved March 4, 197
entitled " An Act Making Provisions for the Naval Service for the Fiscal Year
Ending June 30, 1918, and for other purposes" (13 Stat. 1192), whereby it is
provided "That in case of National emergency The President is authorized to
suspend provisions of law prohibiting more than eight hours labor in any one
day of persons engaged upon work covered by contracts with the United States:
Provided, further, that the wages of persons employed upon such contracts
shall be computed on a basic day rate of eight hours work, with overtime rates
to be paid for at not less than time and one-half for all hours work in excess
of eight hours", I (d0 hereby suspend the provisions of law prohibiting more
than eight hours of labor in any one (lay by persons engaged in the construction
of the, above-nentii d proposed new structure. This order will take effect
from and after this date.
